stations.title: Elspeth
stations.say: Can the welcome be in React?

stations.title: index.html
stations.text: It loads a script that draws nothing yet.

captions: At Coalbrook Tram Museum, Elspeth wants the welcome screen rebuilt in React.
The page loads a script, but nothing draws anything, so the screen stays blank.
You write App's parts as components and put App on the screen, in four tasks.
The entrance hall shows the museum's name, the opening hours and the footer.
Same welcome as before, now built from parts the other screens can reuse.
